excerpt.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
excerpt.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

texts.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
texts.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

tooltips.zh: 没有足够的£energy£ 能量币来维持与商人城邦的资源交易协定。
tooltips.en: Insufficient £energy£ Energy Credits to maintain resource deals with Trader Enclaves.
